title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 551–600 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Photography is my favorite weekend hobby.
examples.zh: 攝影是我最喜歡的週末嗜好。

examples.en: What hobbies do you enjoy pursuing in your free time?
examples.zh: 你在空閒時間喜歡從事哪些嗜好？

examples.en: Reading and baking are both relaxing hobbies.
examples.zh: 閱讀與烘焙都是令人放鬆的嗜好。

examples.en: My brother loves reading Japanese comic books.
examples.zh: 我弟弟喜歡看日本漫畫書。

examples.en: He has collected hundreds of comic books in his bedroom.
examples.zh: 他在臥室裡收藏了數百本漫畫書。

examples.en: Many popular superhero movies are based on classic comic books.
examples.zh: 許多受歡迎的超級英雄電影都是改編自經典漫畫書。

examples.en: Don't play video games for too long without resting.
examples.zh: 別玩電玩太久而不休息。

examples.en: Playing cooperative video games with friends is very exciting.
examples.zh: 和朋友一起玩合作型電玩遊戲非常刺激。

examples.en: Modern video games feature stunning graphics and complex storylines.
examples.zh: 現代電玩遊戲具備令人驚嘆的畫面與複雜的故事情節。

examples.en: We had a surprise birthday party for Jenny.
examples.zh: 我們為珍妮辦了一場驚喜生日派對。

examples.en: Are you going to attend the company's annual year-end party?
examples.zh: 你會參加公司的年度尾牙派對嗎？

examples.en: The host prepared plenty of tasty food and drinks for the dinner party.
examples.zh: 主人為這場晚餐聚會準備了豐盛美味的食物與飲料。

examples.en: Happy birthday to you! Make three wishes.
examples.zh: 祝你生日快樂！許三個願望吧。

examples.en: She received a lovely handwritten card on her eighteenth birthday.
examples.zh: 她在十八歲生日時收到了一張溫馨的手寫卡片。

examples.en: We celebrated my grandfather's birthday with a family feast.
examples.zh: 我們用一場全家盛宴來慶祝我祖父的生日。

examples.en: She received many wonderful gifts on her birthday.
examples.zh: 她在生日時收到了許多很棒的禮物。

examples.en: The box of chocolates was wrapped as a lovely gift.
examples.zh: 那盒巧克力被包裝成一份精美的禮物。

examples.en: He has an extraordinary musical gift for composing songs.
examples.zh: 他擁有創作歌曲的非凡音樂天賦。

examples.en: We had a picnic under the cherry blossom trees.
examples.zh: 我們在櫻花樹下野餐。

examples.en: Let's pack sandwiches and cold drinks for tomorrow's park picnic.
examples.zh: 我們為明天的公園野餐準備三明治和冷飲吧。

examples.en: The sunny weekend weather is perfect for a family picnic.
examples.zh: 晴朗的週末天氣非常適合全家出遊野餐。

examples.en: Barbecuing is a popular tradition during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋節烤肉是台灣盛行的傳統。

examples.en: We set up the barbecue grill in the backyard and grilled sausages.
examples.zh: 我們在後院架起烤肉架並烤了香腸。

examples.en: The savory barbecue sauce adds rich flavor to the grilled meat.
examples.zh: 風味濃郁的烤肉醬為烤肉增添了豐富滋味。

examples.en: Camping in the mountains is very peaceful and scenic.
examples.zh: 在山中露營非常寧靜而且風景優美。

examples.en: Remember to bring a warm sleeping bag when you go camping.
examples.zh: 去露營時記得帶上保暖的睡袋。

examples.en: Many families enjoy weekend camping to escape the busy city.
examples.zh: 許多家庭喜歡在週末露營以遠離繁忙喧囂的城市。

examples.en: We went hiking on Elephant Mountain last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們上週六去象山健行。

examples.en: Wear sturdy hiking boots to protect your ankles on rocky trails.
examples.zh: 在崎嶇石徑上健行時要穿著結實的登山鞋以保護腳踝。

examples.en: Morning hiking through the mist is refreshing and energizing.
examples.zh: 在晨霧中健行既提神又令人精力充沛。

examples.en: Flying kites at the seaside park is fun on windy days.
examples.zh: 在風大的日子去海邊公園放風箏很有趣。

examples.en: The colorful dragon kite soared high up in the blue sky.
examples.zh: 色彩繽紛的長龍風箏在蔚藍的天空中高高翱翔。

examples.en: The boy held the kite string tightly as the gust blew.
examples.zh: 強風吹來時小男孩緊緊抓著風箏線。

examples.en: The little girl takes her favorite doll to bed.
examples.zh: 小女孩帶著她最愛的洋娃娃上床睡覺。

examples.en: Her grandmother handmade a beautiful porcelain doll for her.
examples.zh: 她祖母親手為她縫製了一個精美的瓷娃娃。

examples.en: The shelves were filled with vintage dolls in delicate lace dresses.
examples.zh: 架子上擺滿了穿著精緻蕾絲洋裝的復古娃娃。

examples.en: The floor was covered with colorful toys.
examples.zh: 地板上擺滿了形形色色的玩具。

examples.en: Please tidy up your toys and put them into the storage box.
examples.zh: 請把你的玩具整理好並收進收納箱中。

examples.en: Wooden educational toys help foster young children's creativity.
examples.zh: 木製益智玩具能幫助培養幼童的創造力。

examples.en: He learned to play acoustic guitar in high school.
examples.zh: 他在高中學會了彈木吉他。

examples.en: She sang a gentle folk song while playing her guitar.
examples.zh: 她彈著吉他，輕聲唱著一首溫柔的民謠。

examples.en: Playing an electric guitar requires regular practice and patience.
examples.zh: 彈奏電吉他需要持之以恆的練習與耐心。

examples.en: My sister practices playing the piano every evening.
examples.zh: 我妹妹每天晚上都練習彈鋼琴。

examples.en: The soft piano melody echoed through the empty concert hall.
examples.zh: 柔和的鋼琴旋律在空曠的音樂廳內迴盪。

examples.en: He has been taking classical piano lessons since age five.
examples.zh: 他從五歲起就一直在上古典鋼琴課。

examples.en: The violin soloist performed beautifully on stage.
examples.zh: 小提琴獨奏家在舞台上演奏得非常優美。

examples.en: A good violin produces a warm, rich, and expressive tone.
examples.zh: 一把優質的小提琴能發出溫暖、渾厚且富有表現力的音色。

examples.en: She tuned her violin carefully before the orchestral rehearsal began.
examples.zh: 在管弦樂團彩排開始前，她仔細地為小提琴調音。

examples.en: She plays the flute in the school concert band.
examples.zh: 她在學校管樂團裡吹長笛。

examples.en: The clear, sweet notes of the silver flute charmed the audience.
examples.zh: 銀製長笛清脆甜美的音符吸引了在場的觀眾。

examples.en: Learn how to breathe steadily when practicing the flute.
examples.zh: 練習長笛時要學會如何穩定地調節呼吸。

examples.en: The drummer keeps a steady beat for the song.
examples.zh: 鼓手為整首歌曲維持穩定的節拍。

examples.en: Thunder rolled in the distance like the pounding of giant drums.
examples.zh: 遠處傳來的雷聲猶如巨鼓的轟鳴敲擊。

examples.en: Traditional lion dances are accompanied by loud drum rhythms.
examples.zh: 傳統舞獅表演伴隨著響亮振奮的鼓聲節奏。

examples.en: Mayday is Taiwan's most famous rock band.
examples.zh: 五月天是台灣最著名的搖滾樂團。

examples.en: The school marching band led the morning street parade.
examples.zh: 學校的行進樂旗隊引領了早晨的踩街遊行。

examples.en: He formed an indie pop band with three college classmates.
examples.zh: 他和三位大學同學組建了一支獨立流行樂團。

examples.en: We bought tickets to attend the arena concert.
examples.zh: 我們買了小巨蛋演唱會的門票。

examples.en: The classical piano concert attracted thousands of music lovers.
examples.zh: 這場古典鋼琴音樂會吸引了數千名音樂愛好者。

examples.en: Fans sang along enthusiastically at the outdoor rock concert.
examples.zh: 歌迷們在戶外搖滾演唱會上熱情地跟著大合唱。

examples.en: The audience cheered loudly for the winning team.
examples.zh: 觀眾為獲勝的隊伍大聲歡呼喝采。

examples.en: Her thoughtful words helped cheer me up after a hard day.
examples.zh: 在她貼心的安慰下，我度過辛勞一天後心情好轉了。

examples.en: Cheerleaders waved bright pom-poms to encourage the runners.
examples.zh: 啦啦隊員揮舞著鮮艷的彩球為跑者加油打氣。

examples.en: Our school baseball team won the championship game.
examples.zh: 我們學校的棒球隊贏得了冠軍賽。

examples.en: Hard work and consistent practice will help you win competitions.
examples.zh: 勤奮努力與持續不懈的練習將助你在比賽中獲勝。

examples.en: She felt overjoyed to win first prize in the national contest.
examples.zh: 在全國大賽中榮獲首獎讓她感到欣喜若狂。

examples.en: Don't lose hope even if you fail this time.
examples.zh: 即使這次失敗了，也千萬不要失去希望。

examples.en: Be careful not to lose your passport while traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊時千萬要小心別遺失了護照。

examples.en: Our basketball team fought hard and did not want to lose the final match.
examples.zh: 我們的籃球隊奮力拚搏，不想輸掉這場決賽。

examples.en: Good teamwork is essential to win this match.
examples.zh: 良好的團隊合作是贏得這場比賽的關鍵。

examples.en: Our sales team achieved record revenue during the past quarter.
examples.zh: 我們的業務團隊在上一季度創下了歷史新高的營業額。

examples.en: Each team member brings distinct skills and creative perspectives.
examples.zh: 每位團隊成員都帶來了獨特的技能與創新的視角。

examples.en: Every player on the court gave their best effort.
examples.zh: 球場上的每位球員都全力以赴。

examples.en: He is regarded as the most talented soccer player in the league.
examples.zh: 他被公認是該聯賽中最有天賦的足球選手。

examples.en: In multiplayer online games, players need to communicate clearly.
examples.zh: 在多人線上遊戲中，玩家們需要清晰地保持溝通。

examples.en: We watched an exciting soccer match on TV.
examples.zh: 我們在電視上看了一場刺激的足球比賽。

examples.en: Be cautious when striking a match near flammable objects.
examples.zh: 在易燃物附近劃火柴時一定要格外謹慎。

examples.en: Your navy blue tie matches your crisp white shirt perfectly.
examples.zh: 你的深藍色領帶與純白襯衫搭配得完美無暇。

examples.en: Taiwan's baseball team became the world champion!
examples.zh: 台灣棒球隊成為了世界冠軍！

examples.en: He trained rigorously for months to defend his title as boxing champion.
examples.zh: 他嚴格訓練了數個月以捍衛自己的拳擊冠軍頭銜。

examples.en: The grand champion received a sparkling trophy and monetary reward.
examples.zh: 總冠軍獲得了一座閃亮的獎盃與豐厚的獎金。

examples.en: She won first prize in the English speech contest.
examples.zh: 她在英語演講比賽中榮獲第一名。

examples.en: The Nobel Prize honors outstanding contributions to humanity.
examples.zh: 諾貝爾獎表彰對全人類有傑出貢獻的人士。

examples.en: The raffle winners were delighted with their lucky prizes.
examples.zh: 摸彩抽中獎項的得主們對抽到的好禮感到十分欣喜。

examples.en: The athlete took home a shining gold medal.
examples.zh: 這位運動員帶回了一面閃亮的金牌。

examples.en: Taiwan earned multiple Olympic medals in badminton and weightlifting.
examples.zh: 台灣在羽球與舉重項目中贏得了多面奧運獎牌。

examples.en: She proudly wore the silver medal around her neck.
examples.zh: 她驕傲地將那面銀牌掛在脖子上。

examples.en: Taiwanese night markets offer delicious street snacks.
examples.zh: 台灣夜市提供美味的街頭小吃點心。

examples.en: Fresh apples and unsalted nuts are nutritious afternoon snacks.
examples.zh: 新鮮蘋果和無調味堅果是營養的下午茶點心。

examples.en: Let's stop by the convenience store to grab a quick snack.
examples.zh: 我們順路去便利商店買份簡便的點心吧。

examples.en: Eating sweet popcorn while watching movies is fun.
examples.zh: 邊看電影邊吃甜爆米花很有樂趣。

examples.en: The movie theater smelled delightfully of warm buttered popcorn.
examples.zh: 電影院裡瀰漫著溫熱奶油爆米花的怡人香氣。

examples.en: We made fresh popcorn at home using a microwave popper.
examples.zh: 我們用微波爐專用鍋在家爆了熱騰騰的新鮮爆米花。

examples.en: You can buy steaming hot dogs at convenience stores.
examples.zh: 你可以在便利商店買到熱騰騰的熱狗。

examples.en: Squeeze mustard and ketchup generously onto your hot dog.
examples.zh: 在你的熱狗上大方擠上黃芥末醬和番茄醬。

examples.en: Hot dogs are a classic treat served at American baseball games.
examples.zh: 熱狗是在美國棒球比賽中供應的經典美食。

examples.en: I ordered a burger with a side of crispy French fries.
examples.zh: 我點了一個漢堡附帶一份酥脆薯條。

examples.en: Dip your hot French fries into tangy tomato ketchup.
examples.zh: 把熱呼呼的薯條沾上酸甜濃郁的番茄醬。

examples.en: Freshly fried French fries taste best when seasoned with salt.
examples.zh: 剛炸好的薯條撒上一點鹽巴調味時滋味最棒。

examples.en: Crispy fried chicken is irresistible and mouthwatering.
examples.zh: 酥脆的炸雞令人難以抗拒且垂涎三尺。

examples.en: Taiwanese salted crispy fried chicken is famous worldwide.
examples.zh: 台灣的鹹酥雞在全世界都享負盛名。

examples.en: We ordered a large bucket of fried chicken for the Friday party.
examples.zh: 我們為週五派對訂購了一大桶炸雞。

examples.en: Glazed donuts pair perfectly with black coffee.
examples.zh: 糖霜甜甜圈與黑咖啡是絕配。

examples.en: The bakery offers chocolate-filled donuts every morning.
examples.zh: 這家麵包烘焙坊每天早晨都供應巧克力夾心甜甜圈。

examples.en: Children love donuts coated in colorful sugar sprinkles.
examples.zh: 小朋友們非常喜愛裹上繽紛彩色糖粒的甜甜圈。

examples.en: Hot chocolate is wonderful on a cold rainy day.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的雨天喝杯熱巧克力真是太棒了。

examples.en: Dark chocolate contains antioxidants that are beneficial to health.
examples.zh: 黑巧克力含有對人體健康有益的抗氧化物質。

examples.en: He gifted a heart-shaped box of artisan chocolates to his sweetheart.
examples.zh: 他送給心上人一盒精緻的手工心型巧克力。

examples.en: Spread a thin layer of butter on warm toast.
examples.zh: 在熱吐司上抹上一層薄薄的奶油。

examples.en: Melt the unsalted butter in a skillet before frying pancakes.
examples.zh: 煎鬆餅前先將無鹽奶油放在平底鍋中融化。

examples.en: Fresh homemade cookies smell rich because of high-grade butter.
examples.zh: 剛出爐的手工餅乾因使用頂級奶油而散發濃郁香氣。

examples.en: Say cheese before taking the photo!
examples.zh: 拍照前說 cheese（笑一個）！

examples.en: The pizza is topped with melted mozzarella cheese.
examples.zh: 披薩表面鋪滿了熱騰騰融化的莫札瑞拉起司。

examples.en: Gouda and Cheddar are two well-known varieties of cheese.
examples.zh: 高達與切達是兩款著名的起司乳酪品種。

examples.en: Strawberry jam on toast is my favorite breakfast.
examples.zh: 吐司抹草莓果醬是我最愛的早餐。

examples.en: We were stuck in a heavy traffic jam on the highway for hours.
examples.zh: 我們在高速公路上的嚴重塞車中受困了好幾個小時。

examples.en: Grandma boiled sweet ripe blueberries to make homemade fruit jam.
examples.zh: 奶奶將香甜成熟的藍莓熬煮成果醬。

examples.en: Lemon honey water is very soothing for a sore throat.
examples.zh: 檸檬蜂蜜水對喉嚨痛非常具有舒緩效果。

examples.en: Honey never spoils if kept sealed in a cool, dry place.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜密封存放在陰涼乾燥處時永遠不會變質。

examples.en: 'Honey, could you please pass me the car keys?' she asked.
examples.zh: 「親愛的，可以請你幫我遞一下車鑰匙嗎？」她問道。

examples.en: Mashed potatoes go well with roast chicken.
examples.zh: 馬鈴薯泥與烤雞非常搭。

examples.en: Baked potatoes topped with sour cream are delicious.
examples.zh: 淋上酸奶醬的烤馬鈴薯美味可口。

examples.en: Farmers harvest fresh potatoes from the soil in autumn.
examples.zh: 農夫們在秋天從泥土裡採收新鮮的馬鈴薯。

examples.en: Cherry tomatoes grown in Chiayi are very sweet.
examples.zh: 嘉義種植的玉女小番茄非常香甜。

examples.en: Slice fresh red tomatoes to add inside the turkey sandwich.
examples.zh: 切幾片新鮮紅番茄加入火雞三明治中。

examples.en: Tomato scrambled eggs is a beloved comfort dish in Taiwanese households.
examples.zh: 番茄炒蛋是深受台灣家庭喜愛的家常暖心料理。

examples.en: Chopping onions can easily make your eyes water.
examples.zh: 切洋蔥很容易讓人流眼淚。

examples.en: Sautéed sweet onions bring a wonderful aroma to beef stew.
examples.zh: 拌炒香甜的洋蔥為燉牛肉增添了絕妙的香氣。

examples.en: Crispy deep-fried onion rings are a popular pub appetizer.
examples.zh: 酥脆的炸洋蔥圈是受歡迎的酒吧開胃點心。

examples.en: Carrots are rich in vitamin A, which is good for vision.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔富含維生素 A，對視力有益。

examples.en: Rabbits enjoy nibbling on fresh crunchy raw carrots.
examples.zh: 兔子喜歡啃食新鮮爽脆的生胡蘿蔔。

examples.en: Chop the carrots into bite-sized cubes for vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 把胡蘿蔔切成適口的小丁塊放進蔬菜湯裡。

examples.en: Stir-fried cabbage with garlic is a classic home-cooked dish.
examples.zh: 蒜炒高麗菜是一道經典的家常菜。

examples.en: Mountain-grown cabbage from Lishan is famed for its crisp sweetness.
examples.zh: 梨山出產的高山高麗菜以其清脆鮮甜聞名。

examples.en: Shred fresh cabbage finely to make refreshing homemade coleslaw.
examples.zh: 將新鮮高麗菜切成細絲以製作爽口的自製涼拌捲心菜。

examples.en: Sweet corn soup is popular with kids and adults alike.
examples.zh: 甜玉米濃湯深受大人小孩喜愛。

examples.en: Grilled corn brushed with savory barbecue sauce smells heavenly.
examples.zh: 塗上鹹香烤肉醬的烤玉米聞起來令人垂涎。

examples.en: Farmers cultivate fields of yellow corn throughout the fertile valley.
examples.zh: 農民在肥沃的山谷各處種植了大片黃金玉米田。

words.definition: 蘑菇；香菇；雨後春筍般迅速增加

examples.en: Shiitake mushrooms are widely used in Taiwanese soups.
examples.zh: 香菇在台灣湯品中被廣泛使用。

examples.en: Sauté button mushrooms with garlic and butter for a savory side dish.
examples.zh: 用大蒜和奶油拌炒洋菇，是一道風味絕佳的配菜。

examples.en: Coffee shops have mushroomed rapidly across the metropolis.
examples.zh: 咖啡館如雨後春筍般在都會區迅速激增。

examples.en: Minced garlic gives a rich flavor to stir-fries.
examples.zh: 蒜末能為熱炒增添濃郁風味。

examples.en: Garlic bread toasted golden brown is the perfect pasta companion.
examples.zh: 烤至金黃微焦的蒜香麵包是義大利麵的完美搭檔。

examples.en: Crush two cloves of garlic before adding them into the marinade.
examples.zh: 在將蒜頭加入醃料之前先將兩瓣大蒜壓碎。

examples.en: Hot ginger tea is great for warming up in winter.
examples.zh: 熱薑茶在冬天暖身效果極佳。

examples.en: Add a few slices of fresh ginger to balance seafood dishes.
examples.zh: 加入幾片新鮮薑絲以中和海鮮料理的寒涼與去腥。

examples.en: Ginger candies are often taken by travelers to relieve motion sickness.
examples.zh: 旅行者經常吃薑糖來緩解暈車或暈船的不適。

examples.en: Stinky tofu is a famous Taiwanese night market specialty.
examples.zh: 臭豆腐是著名的台灣夜市特色小吃。

examples.en: Silken tofu drizzled with soy sauce and bonito flakes is refreshing.
examples.zh: 嫩豆腐淋上醬油膏並撒上柴魚片非常爽口開胃。

examples.en: Tofu is an outstanding plant-based protein source for vegetarians.
examples.zh: 豆腐對素食者而言是絕佳的植物性蛋白質來源。
